mentions.name: SingOnKey
mentions.description: A singing training app for bad singers: users sing the pitch line and get a score, and can sing to any original song by listening along rather than the app playing the song itself. Work is under way on Linux and Windows versions, and on internationalizing the app and landing page.
mentions.audience: Bad singers who want to train their singing
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://singonkey.app

A singing training app for bad singers. You sing the pitch line and get a score. Let's you sing to any original song by listening along and not playing the song itself.
mentions.author: dsmurrell
